title: ShieldCare Premium Invoices: the Discount Earned by the Payment Record
content:
A premium invoice on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan earns a discount for the payment record of the
store credit account the profile holds under Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts: the days of
terms the account runs on, and whether a payment was received on it inside the last 30 days.

| What the account shows | The discount for the account's payment record |
| --- | --- |
| the store credit account runs on terms of 30 days or more, and a payment was received on it inside the last 30 days | 2 percent |
| that account runs on terms of 30 days or more, and no payment was received on it inside the last 30 days | 1 percent |
| every other profile | no discount for the account's payment record is allowed |

### Both sides of the two figures

Terms of exactly 30 days are 30 days or more and reach the schedule; terms of 29 days do not, and no
discount is allowed. A payment received exactly 30 days ago is inside the last 30 days and earns 2
percent; one received 31 days ago is outside them and earns 1 percent.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

On a total of 200.00 carried by the invoice and the periods in advance together:

| Terms | Last payment on the account | Discount | Total after the discount |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 20 days | 12 days ago | none | 200.00 |
| 45 days | 90 days ago | 1 percent | 198.00 |
| 45 days | 12 days ago | 2 percent | 196.00 |
